state_meanings.blocked: Specific local/external blocker prevents all safe local slices; evidence is recorded.
state_meanings.complete: Done condition is verified or user explicitly stops/changes target.

do_not_redo: Do not reconstruct continuation state from chat when this ledger and events.jsonl are available; read them first.

Do not treat push/PR/rebase/squash as required before continuing safe local work; those remain gated while local slices may proceed.
Do not use PATH-only Godot checks; run repo-local ./run_godot.sh for TV verification.
Do not treat EV adaptations/Godot logs as Classic truth; label them as hypothesis or Terminal Velocity evidence until original/resource/manual support exists.
Do not repeat broad source mining when the next_resume_action names a bounded source-aligned slice; inspect the live backlog and choose the strongest adjacent slice.
